subject: Re: Urgent capacity request / prioritization for NorthStar Sept launch
messages:
From: Lana Brodie <lana.brodie@northstar.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@northstar.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Dedicated capacity for Sept product launch

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Quick note — NorthStar is going live with a major public launch in mid-September and we need dedicated capacity commitments to ensure latency and throughput during the first 14 days of traffic. Our rough ask: 12x A100-equivalent GPUs for production (steady) with ability to burst to 20x for the first 72 hours.

We understand capacity is constrained across your customers, but this launch is time-boxed and critical to our go-to-market. Can Redwood prioritize this ramp and confirm whether a guaranteed allocation + short-term burst is doable? If needed we can sign a 3-month reserve and are open to a premium for ramp capacity.

I've cc'd procurement for contract discussions. Would appreciate a response by EOD today so we can coordinate our internal release plan.

Thanks,
Lana Brodie
VP Engineering, NorthStar AI
lana.brodie@northstar.ai

--
Attachment: launch_readiness_overview.pdf (stub)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Dedicated capacity for Sept product launch

Marcus / Marissa — forwarding NorthStar's ask (below). Short version: 12 steady, burst to 20 for 72h. Timeline: mid-Sept launch, need final confirmation today.

We have the following constraints:
- Current Dedicated pool is ~120 A100-equivalent across US region; 3 large reserved customers (OrbitAI, NimbusHealth, Aurum) have existing commitments that consume ~90 of those under peak.
- Autoscaling policies and burst budgets are allocated but not all customers consume their full bursts; we can reassign some burst capacity but it will degrade their buffer.

Options on the table (rapid evaluation):
1) Short-term burst reallocation: shift up to 8 GPUs of burst from mid-tier customers (requires approval and customer notice).
2) Temporary pre-emption of unutilized warm pools: identify low-utilization pools and reassign for 72h (operational risk, needs infra sign-off).
3) Tiered performance: offer NorthStar a hybrid queue (10 guaranteed; allow 10 more best-effort non-guaranteed) and discount for best-effort portion.
4) Fast-track reserved capacity: accept a 3-month commit at higher price and temporarily bump their priority in scheduler (requires leadership sign-off).

I need a recommendation ASAP. If we push option 4 we should prepare a short canary rollback plan and compensation offer for impacted customers. Marcus — can you run a quick snapshot of current burst headroom and which customers are safe to touch? Marissa — if we signal customers, what's the minimum notice we can give without breaking SLAs? Jonas — need your call if leadership wants to prioritize this ARR-heavy renewal.

Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Dedicated capacity for Sept product launch — quick capacity snapshot + proposal

Karthik / Marissa,

I pulled the capacity snapshot as of 14:15 PT and attached a short pack: capacity_snapshot_0901.pdf. Quick notes:
- Confirmed steady commitments consume ~88 A100-e; peak headroom ~32 across the region if we reconfigure burst budgets.
- 3 customers currently using burst budgets conservatively (OrbitAI, small test windows) — we can reassign up to 6 GPUs of burst with 24h notice with low risk.
- Warm pools: ~4 GPUs are in warm pools that can be repurposed for immediate runs, but that introduces a 30–45m cold-start risk for those customers.

Proposal (fast lane):
A) Offer NorthStar 10 guaranteed GPUs + 10 best-effort burst for 72h.
B) If NorthStar signs a 3-month reserve at 1.3x list price, we will guarantee 12 steady GPUs and an extra 8 burst for the 72h window (total burst capacity to 20) — requires exec sign-off and a short amendment to the contract.
C) Compensate any customers impacted by pre-emption with service credits equal to 10% of the monthly committed spend for the impacted window.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_NorthStar.xlsx (proposal + timelines), capacity_snapshot_0901.pdf, dedicated_sla_redline.docx (legal redlines).

If leadership OKs option B we can fast-track a DocuSign rider; if not, option A is a pragmatic near-term solution.

Marcus Lin
Head of Field Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

--
Attachment stubs: mutual_action_plan_NorthStar.xlsx, capacity_snapshot_0901.pdf, dedicated_sla_redline.docx
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@northstar.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lana Brodie <lana.brodie@northstar.ai>, procurement@northstar.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Dedicated capacity for Sept product launch

Karthik / team — thanks for the quick follow. We discussed internally and can accept Proposal A (10 guaranteed + 10 best-effort burst) as an initial path so long as we get firm dates and a clear escalation path if the best-effort portion is not available during the 72h window. Procurement will also review the 3-month reserved rider; they prefer to avoid the higher price but want the contractual guarantee if things go sideways.

Action items on our side:
- Procurement to review the DocuSign rider by tomorrow EOD.
- We need confirmation of the start time (we aim for 2026-09-15 06:00 PT) and the duration of the ramp window.

Happy to proceed with the hybrid approach while procurement negotiates the longer commit. Please confirm scheduler hooks and a single escalation contact.

Sandeep Rao
Head of Infrastructure, NorthStar AI
sandeep@northstar.ai

--

Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Dedicated capacity for Sept product launch — final allocation decision

All — thank you for the quick coordination. Final decision: we will proceed with Proposal A as the default operating posture: 10 guaranteed GPUs + up to 10 best-effort burst for the 72h launch window starting 2026-09-15 06:00 PT.

Operational notes (internal):
- Marcus / infra: reserve the warm pools and reconfigure burst budgets to allow up to 10 additional burst slots; prioritize pre-emption order: (1) low-utilization test tenants, (2) warm pools, (3) reassign burst budgets from mid-tier customers.
- Notify impacted customers with a 24h heads-up and offer 10% service credit per impacted month for the window if they observe measurable degradation.
- Legal: finalize the DocuSign rider for the 3-month reserve path; procurement will sign if the rider contains the guarantee language.

Sandeep / NorthStar: we will confirm scheduler hooks and single escalation contact by EOD Monday 2026-09-07. I'm adding a short allocation-change-log entry to track who touched the scheduler and when. See attachment reference: allocation-change-log.txt

Deal ID: NS-2026-9876
Next steps: Marcus to post verification snapshot by 2026-09-07 17:00 PT; Marissa to draft customer notice template.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
